qa_pair.question: You need to convert a local CSV named C:\path\to\scores.csv, inspect only a short preview first, then continue reading if the response is truncated. Which exact ordered MCP tools should you use? Answer as comma-separated tool names.
You submitted a long PDF conversion asynchronously and received a job id. Which tool should you poll until the job reaches completed, failed, or cancelled? Answer with the exact tool name.

You need to confirm available engines, then submit a long conversion job, then page the saved output after completion. Which exact ordered MCP tools should you use? Answer as comma-separated tool names.
A user asks whether configured provider secrets are present, but you must not reveal API keys. Which MCP tool lists settings with sensitive values masked? Answer with the exact tool name.
You need to read one persisted setting named openai_api_key while preserving secret masking. Which MCP tool should you call? Answer with the exact tool name.
A conversion response returns truncated=true and next_offset=20000. Which tool and offset should be used for the next page? Answer in the form tool:offset.
A user provides ftp://example.com/file.pdf as source_url. Based on Marker MCP safety rules, should the conversion URL be accepted or rejected? Answer accepted or rejected.

For cloud image understanding, which boolean parameter must remain false unless the user explicitly permits sending image crops to a configured cloud VLM provider? Answer with the exact parameter name.
You want MCP HTTP reachable from 0.0.0.0. Which environment variable must be set so the server requires bearer authentication? Answer with the exact variable name.
You need to verify registered tools and run the deterministic TSV conversion smoke check from an MCP client. Which tool should you call? Answer with the exact tool name.
